LanguageData.MWAH.FloatMenu.KissTooltip: Walk over, face {TARGET}, share a kiss, then both return to where they stood.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.OptionTooltip: Walk over and kiss the {WALL}. The wall won't answer — the mood is pure fate.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.Disabled: kissing is disabled in mod settings
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.Gone: one of them is no longer here
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.Stale: that kiss is no longer on
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.Unconscious: {PAWN} is asleep or out of it
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.NoMouth: {PAWN} has no working mouth to kiss with
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.TooYoung: {PAWN} is not old enough to start a kiss
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.SociallyIncapable: {PAWN} is past anything as subtle as affection
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.RitualAbsorbed: {PAWN} is wrapped up in the ritual
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.Busy: already in the middle of a kiss
LanguageData.MWAH.Fail.InCombat: {PAWN} is in a fight and can't be pulled away
LanguageData.MWAH.KissThing.Fail.NoStandCell: {PAWN} can't find a standable, reachable spot to kiss that {WALL}
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Result.Weird: {PAWN} leaned in and kissed {WALL}. The instant lips met stone, {PAWN} froze.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Result.Nothing: {PAWN} kissed {WALL}. Nothing happened — exactly as {PAWN} hoped.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Result.Slight: {PAWN} kissed {WALL}. The stone was just the right temperature.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Result.Devoted: {PAWN} kissed {WALL} with true devotion, then lingered.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.0: {PAWN} kissed {WALL}. Nothing then — and, uncomfortably, something three minutes later.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.1: Now every route walks {PAWN} past that wall, and every pass replays the moment.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.2: The doctor mentioned that people do this too. {PAWN} would rather not have learned that.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.3: {PAWN} tried to explain it away as a momentary impulse, and by the second telling had stopped believing it.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.4: Since that day {PAWN} has been reading up on load-bearing structures, not entirely by choice.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.5: {PAWN} dreamt about the wall, and keeps a professional silence about the plot.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.6: Someone asked why {PAWN} keeps staring at that wall. {PAWN} had no answer that would survive saying it aloud.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.7: The regret arrived right after the kiss and stayed far longer than the kiss itself.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.8: On the psych eval form, the box marked "recent unusual impulses" took a long time to answer.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Weird.9: {PAWN} now walks faster past {WALL}, as if the cell required routing around.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.0: {PAWN} kissed {WALL}. Nothing happened, and that was that.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.1: {PAWN} kissed {WALL}, returned to work, and never lost a beat.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.2: If the kiss had to be filed as a report, the body would read simply: "done".
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.3: {PAWN} feels about {WALL} exactly what {PAWN} feels about every other wall.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.4: The entire meaning of the kiss: lips confirmed a temperature.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.5: Someone asked what {PAWN} was doing. {PAWN} answered honestly, and the conversation ended out of mercy.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.6: {PAWN} kissed {WALL} and left without looking back. Not once.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.7: No mood shift, no schedule change, not even a mark on the tile where {PAWN} stood.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.8: The kiss's one redeeming quality is that it did, in fact, occur.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Nothing.9: To {PAWN}, kissing a wall turned out to be like breathing: done, and instantly forgotten.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.0: {PAWN} kissed {WALL}. The stone was just the right temperature, and the next two hours went smoothly.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.1: The wall faces west and holds the afternoon sun. {PAWN} considers this a good use of a mouth.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.2: {PAWN} can't say what was nice about it, only that footsteps got lighter passing {WALL}.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.3: After one kiss, {PAWN} developed a plain appreciation for colonial masonry.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.4: {PAWN} kissed {WALL}, felt good, and worked a little harder. The wall contributed nothing and objected to less.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.5: Nothing special happened, except {PAWN}'s mouth stayed slightly up for a while.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.6: {PAWN} mentioned the kiss to someone else, and the tone came out almost like a recommendation.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.7: The wall stood very steadily, and some of that steadiness caught.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.8: {PAWN} was thinking about something else during the kiss, and finished thinking in a better mood.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Slight.9: If satisfaction had a volume, the footsteps leaving {WALL} would be the measurement.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.0: {PAWN} shared a long kiss with {WALL}. Draft came through the door; {PAWN} has decided to call it a reply.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.1: There was a hint of moss-moisture in the seam, and {PAWN} insists it was not ordinary water.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.2: {PAWN} stood there long after the kiss, long enough for bystanders to start exchanging glances.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.3: Someone said the wall seemed warmer. Then they noticed there was no evidence.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.4: {PAWN} told a close friend about the kiss and teared up halfway through telling it.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.5: {PAWN} slept badly that night; the causes were complex, and one wall featured prominently.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.6: {PAWN} has started taking the long way around, on purpose, past {WALL}, and calls it a walk.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.7: The wall changed nothing. The way {PAWN} looks at it changed everything available to look at.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.8: Since that kiss, {PAWN} walks softer indoors, as if afraid of waking something.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Moved.9: The warden wrote "on duty" in the log, then rubbed their eyes.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.0: {PAWN} kissed {WALL} with true devotion, then lingered. Love need not be mutual.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.1: It doesn't speak, doesn't leave, doesn't judge — {PAWN} considers these three facts to beat most coworkers.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.2: {PAWN} announced a perfect partner to everyone, then noticed there was no everyone.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.3: {PAWN} now sleeps at the foot of {WALL}, and insists this is a bedding issue, not a romance issue.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.4: Asked what {WALL} has going for it, {PAWN} began with load-bearing and talked about silence for a long time.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.5: {PAWN} has started dusting that wall, gently, the way one fixes someone's hair.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.6: The kiss gained nothing mechanically and completed, apparently, the most important stress analysis of {PAWN}'s life.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.7: {PAWN} no longer looks at other walls. The commitment has begun to worry the architects.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.8: No repair bill will ever carry this line: {WALL} requires gentle handling.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissWall.Line.Devoted.9: The silence of stone is said to be deafening; {PAWN} has learned to hear vows in it.
LanguageData.MWAH.Director.Title: kiss director
LanguageData.MWAH.Director.LeftPicked: {PAWN} is going to start the kiss.
LanguageData.MWAH.Director.HeartReady: {PAWN} wants to kiss {OTHER} - click to send them.
LanguageData.MWAH.Director.HeartWaiting: Fill both slots and the heart turns red.
LanguageData.MWAH.Director.QuickSendDesc: Skip the slots: click one pawn on the map to start, click the other to be kissed - dispatched the moment the second pick lands, and the slots show what was sent.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.TimingHint: Every duration is stored in ticks and shown as ticks / real seconds / game hours. Reference: 60 t = 1 real second at 1x speed, 2500 t = 1 game hour, 60000 t = 1 game day.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.EnabledDesc: Master switch. Off removes the right-click option; ongoing kisses finish normally.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.DurationDesc: How long the two stand there kissing. Hearts spawn repeatedly inside this window.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.FleckIntervalDesc: Gap between heart bursts. Vanilla lovemakin' uses 100 t.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.PawnCooldownDesc: How long a pawn must wait before kissing anyone again. Vanilla social interactions only cool down for 120 t.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.PairCooldownDesc: How long the same two pawns must wait before kissing each other again. Set to 0 for free-for-all.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.ThoughtDurationDesc: How long the mood bonus lingers after a kiss.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.MoodMultiplierDesc: Scales the final mood bonus. Actual bonus = thought base x this x the pawn's own social impact, so a smooth talker gets more out of a kiss than a mute grump.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.NoCooldownsDesc: The director's hand is an archotech hand: per-pawn and per-pair cooldowns no longer apply, so you can pair anyone again immediately. Pawns already kissing still finish first.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.DirectorButtonDesc: Puts the kiss director on the bottom bar. Click it, click whoever starts the kiss, then click who they kiss - any two pawns on the map, including ones you do not control.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.PairScopeDesc: How wide the door stands. Fully right means no limit on faction or species - that is the point of the mod. Drag left to narrow it to your colony if you want a matchmaking toy instead. Both sides must be inside the range; it only ever widens, so each step adds exactly one group.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.Scope.ColonyOwned: everything you own (adds animals and mechs - no mood, gesture only)
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.Scope.AllFlesh: + all flesh (adds wild animals, insects, fleshbeasts)
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.AutonomousDesc: Pawns you cannot give orders to - raiders, visitors, wild animals, mechanoids - start kissing on their own. Player-controlled pawns are never auto-ordered; they still wait for your right-click. This is the only way to reach "every pawn" without patching the game.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.AutonomousIntervalDesc: How often the map gets one chance to start an autonomous kiss. The per-pawn and per-pair cooldowns still apply, so this is a ceiling, not a guarantee.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.AutonomousRadiusDesc: Only pawns already this close will consider it. Without a limit a raider would cross the whole map to kiss someone, and the battle turns into a sightseeing tour.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.ChangeOpinionDesc: Also shift how the two pawns feel about each other. This feeds the vanilla romance chain - keep it off if you just want silly kissing.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.ReturnHomeDesc: Afterwards both pawn go back to where the kiss was ordered. A polite request - urgent needs and work still win.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.DiagnosticsDesc: Writes [MWAH] dev events to Player.log and lets the 1 Hz phase sampler append to Mwah-trace.log in the game's save data folder. The startup banner and error lines print regardless. Default on in dev builds, off in release builds.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.WallKissingDesc: Right-click to kiss a wall — built walls, natural rock, even buried ore veins. The wall never answers, so the mood is pure fate: it may haunt you, or you may fall in love on the spot. Independent of the "who kisses whom" scope slider.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.0: The moment their lips parted, {PAWN} understood every bad love song ever written.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.1: The warmth of this kiss probably won't outlast the next rain — {PAWN} decides to keep it anyway.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.2: {PAWN} stole a glance at {WALL} right after. Good: the glance was mutual.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.3: The kiss was short. The work shifts spent replaying it were not.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.4: If dopamine kept a ledger, {WALL} owes {PAWN} an entry today.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.5: {PAWN} decides this one goes in no report. It stays on the face instead.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.6: Being kissed and being colonized turn out to be different things — {PAWN} told them apart today for the first time.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.7: That single moment outweighs the season's whole food ration, calories aside.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.8: {PAWN} feels like laughing without knowing why, and returns to work anyway.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Line.9: {WALL}'s lips were colder than expected and the afterglow warmer. {PAWN} files both under accurate.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.0: {PAWN}'s vision processor tagged the contact as "non-combat fluid exchange event", then resumed patrol.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.1: No heartbeat, no hormones — yet {PAWN}'s locomotion script idled 0.4 seconds longer than usual. That is its blush.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.2: {PAWN} searched every known etiquette protocol, found no contingency for being kissed, and chose standby.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.3: The kiss produced zero mood data and one unarchivable log entry.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.4: {PAWN}'s speaker emitted a short static blip. Everyone present agreed to translate it as "mm".
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.5: Ask {PAWN} how it felt and it will honestly answer "nothing" — unable to hear that this is not an answer.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.6: {PAWN} filed {WALL}'s lip temperature into its ambient sampling table, right next to yesterday's rain.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.7: The advantage of kissing a mechanoid: it never holds a grudge. The disadvantage: it never remembers either.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.8: {PAWN}'s IFF briefly classified {WALL} as "unknown but harmless" — the ceiling of its romance.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Mech.Line.9: The only technical consequence: {PAWN}'s idle pose has been off by two degrees ever since.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.0: {PAWN} shook its head, filing {WALL}'s scent beside the seventeenth smell of today.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.1: {PAWN} licked back three times. In its worldview, that counts as an engagement.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.2: No words, no mood — just a momentary hesitation of the tail.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.3: {PAWN} memorized the scent, then forgot within five minutes why it mattered.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.4: The kiss bought a two-second head tilt — the humans present unanimously voted to refuse interpretation.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.5: {PAWN}'s only reply was sniffing {WALL}'s pocket. No food inside; interest dissolved.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.6: {PAWN} knows nothing of kisses, but it noticed {WALL}'s heartbeat quicken.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissPawn.Beast.Line.7: The tail wagged twice. This is {PAWN}'s most accurate report on the matter.
